name: Field group nav
description: Adds a <nav> element field-group type for wrapping content in a nav element.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 This module generates a pseudo field - Field group navigation. It provides navigation links within the current document.

Each usage of Nav Item FieldGroupFormatter creates one navigation item.

 Back to top 

 Requirments 
 This module requires the Field Group module ( https://drupal.org/project/field_group )

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Install as usual. 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 To create a field group link, edit the display of any entity (by clicking

 "Manage Display"). 
 Add a new group and select the "Nav item" format. 
 Move some fields under the new created field group. 
 Enable "Field group navigation" 
 Back to top
